ranked.title: Feed limiter and Auto a cached exact per-source RGB histogram instead of re-streaming raw pixels
files: src/lib/source-color-summary.js:49-80 scanSummary (existing per-source pass to extend)
src/App.svelte:228-262 Auto effect (reruns over every wall source on each items change)
ranked.workThatDisappears: Per job: copying every source byte into 128 KiB slices on the main thread, one worker round trip per slice (128 per 2048 sheet per pass), and the worker's per-pixel Map histogram. For Auto: rescanning every unchanged wall source each time an image is added or removed.
ranked.frequency: Every Max colors commit (2->4->8 each re-streams), palette/metric/Opacity-cut change with a cap; Auto on every wall change and Opacity-cut change.
ranked.affectedWorkflow: Max colors edits, palette stepping with a cap, Auto with large sheets/animations, batch imports while Auto is selected.
ranked.expectedBenefit: Probe (desktop Node): limiter input sheet2048 26.4 -> 0.26 ms, sheet1024 6.9 -> 0.24 ms, motion256 (48 frames) 9.1 -> 0.34 ms; Auto sheet2048 25.2 -> 0.08 ms; main-thread slice copies alone 4.6 ms per pass for sheet2048 (desktop profile attributes 19-24 ms self to palette-limit-client onmessage per rapid-settings run). Phone expected 3-5x these absolute values.
ranked.newWorkState: <= 4096 x (4 B RGB + 4 B count) per source, held with the existing WeakMap summary; one counter increment per visible pixel in the existing scanSummary pass; a 'histogram' worker message. Raw streaming stays as fallback.
ranked.exactness: Limiter: histogram weights and frequency[] are integer sums (still weight 1; GIF integer delays), so aggregation order cannot change them; distances/assign iterate the rgb-sorted histogram; the binned (>4096 union) path accumulates floats in pixel order and must keep raw streaming. fullCost differs only in rounding and is metadata (client uses indices only). Auto masses are integers by design. Valid only for sources with no partial alpha (soft=false), where alpha>=cut equals alpha==255 for every cut; soft sources stream raw. Probe: 66 limiter cases (3 palettes x 2 metrics x caps 2/4/8/16 x 3 sources) and 3 Auto cases identical.
ranked.falsifyingProbe: Built app, phone and desktop: sheet2048 Max colors 2->4->8 commits; measure main-thread CPU in limiter client handlers, worker CPU, and time to final paint. Auto: add one sprite to a wall containing sheet2048. Reject if the window improves <10% or a summary-ordering stall appears.
ranked.risk: Ordering: summary is produced by its own serial queue; the limiter/Auto must not wait behind it (fall back to raw if not ready). More code paths in two workers. Summary bailout (>4096 colors) and soft sources keep today's cost.
